retrieve_source_location: retrieve the filepath and line number for a Python function or class using reflection
format_source_location: format a filepath and line number into a renderable text string for treescope output
render_function_with_closure: render a Python function with its closure variables displayed in a foldable treescope tree
render_class_definition: render a Python class definition with its source location annotation in treescope
handle_code_object_reflection: handle rendering of code objects like functions and classes with optional closure variable inspection
